parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description: The name of the risk analysis policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: RiskCategory
parameters.description:
The risk category. Valid values:
* `data_safe`: data security.
* `identify_safe`: identity security.
* `device_safe`: device security.
* `access_safe`: access security.
* `ai_agent_safe`: Agent security.

parameters.name: RiskId
parameters.description: The risk event ID. If specified, the exact risk event is queried.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. Valid values:
* `High`: high risk.
* `Medium`: medium risk.
* `Low`: low risk.

parameters.name: RiskScene
parameters.description:
The risk scenario. Valid values:
* `account_share`: account sharing.
* `account_stolen`: account theft.
* `device_share`: device sharing.
* `remote_logon`: remote logon from an unusual location.
* `sensitive_data_leakage`: sensitive data exfiltration.
* `compressed_archive_exfil`: compressed data exfiltration from the internal network.
* `lateral_scanning`: lateral scanning.
* `ai_skill_malware`: malicious Skill.
* `ai_config_check`: AI configuration check.
* `openclaw_vulnerability`: OpenClaw vulnerability.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The disposition status of the risk event. This parameter cannot be set together with `StatusList`.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description: The list of disposition statuses of risk events, in Flat serialization format. This parameter cannot be set together with Status.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username associated with the risk event. Fuzzy match is supported. Maximum length: 128 characters.
